key_provisions_or_claims: Applies to L3+ autonomous vehicle road testing and demonstration application in Beijing
Applicants apply via the municipal dual-smart office; police issue temporary test plates after review and evaluation
Testing must progress from in-vehicle safety driver to no safety driver, with third-party test reports and mileage thresholds
Significant software/hardware changes affecting safety require re-application
Safety drivers must monitor and take over; traffic violations and accidents handled by traffic police under national rules
annotation.summary_en: Beijing municipal trial measures (Jing Jing Xin Fa [2025] No. 43, 24 Oct 2025) governing road testing and demonstration application of L3+ autonomous vehicles: application and plate issuance, staged safety-driver rules, change management, safety-driver duties, and traffic violation handling, within a policy pilot zone.
annotation.title_clean: 北京市自动驾驶汽车道路测试与示范应用办法（试行）
annotation.title_en: Beijing Measures for Road Testing and Demonstration Application of Autonomous Vehicles (Trial)
